DETERMINISTIC ASSUMPTIONS
Identified primary archetype as "Employee Experience" based on domain vocabulary.
Inferred target audience as "Employees, team leads and people operations teams".
Inferred primary objective: "Help employees connect with their teams, complete onboarding, share feedback and access organisational policies".
Applied feel descriptors "professional but playful" with mathematical DNA adjustments.
Applied Visual Ambition level 30 to motion, typography, and depth.
Applied Structural Creativity level 55 to spatial topology.
